title: GG overview
description: Gateway overview: traffic, latency, cost, cache, routing, breakers, guardrails. Quantiles are interpolated; README numbers come from raw samples.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: sum(rate(gg_requests_total[1m]))

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: 5xx / all requests over 5m (logical status: mid-stream failures count as 5xx).

panels.title: p99 latency (miss)
panels.description: Interpolated p99 of gg_request_duration_seconds for cache misses.

panels.title: Overhead p99
panels.description: Interpolated p99 gateway overhead (total phase); README numbers come from raw samples.

panels.title: Avg cost/request
panels.description: Upstream USD over the range / served cache-miss requests.

panels.title: Cache hit %
panels.description: Requests served from the exact or semantic cache.

panels.title: % strong
panels.description: Share of router decisions that chose the strong tier.

panels.title: In flight
panels.description: Requests currently in flight.

panels.title: Requests/s by status class
panels.description: Logical status: committed streams that fail mid-stream count as 5xx.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: 5xx and 4xx shares of all requests over 5m.

panels.title: Errors by type
panels.description: Failed requests by error_type.

panels.title: Requests/s by alias
panels.description: Client-facing model alias (unknown aliases fold into other).

panels.title: In flight by stream
panels.description: Requests in flight.

panels.title: Client disconnects by phase
panels.description: Client went away before commit, before the first token, mid-stream or on a non-stream call.

panels.title: Event loop lag
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p99 event loop scheduling lag.

panels.title: Request duration (miss)
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p95/p99 of total request duration for cache misses.

panels.title: TTFT by provider
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p99 time to first client byte (streams); provider=cache for hits.

panels.title: Gateway overhead by phase
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p99 of gg_gateway_overhead_seconds per phase (pre_upstream, ttft_added, post, stream_tail, total, failover).

panels.title: Stage p99
panels.description: Interpolated p99 exclusive time per pipeline stage.

panels.title: Upstream duration by deployment
panels.description: Interpolated p50 of successful upstream attempts.

panels.title: Time per output token
panels.description: Interpolated p50 upstream time per output token after the first.

panels.title: Request duration heatmap
panels.description: Distribution of gg_request_duration_seconds (all requests).

panels.title: USD per hour by deployment
panels.description: sum(rate(gg_cost_usd_total[1h])) * 3600, stacked by deployment.

panels.title: Cost per request
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p95 of gg_request_cost_usd per served request.

panels.title: Savings: cache and routing (estimate)
panels.description: Cache: upstream USD avoided by hits. Routing: strong-equivalent cost of weak-routed requests minus their actual cost (estimate, same tokens at strong prices).

panels.title: Tokens/s by type
panels.description: Upstream tokens; input includes cached and cache-write, output includes reasoning.

panels.title: Upstream prompt-cache ratio and estimated usage
panels.description: cached_input / input tokens, and the share of tokens whose usage was estimated (provider sent none).

panels.title: Pricing gaps and spend-guard blocks
panels.description: Usage that could not be priced, and upstream attempts refused by the provider spend cap.

panels.title: Served from cache
panels.description: Exact + semantic hits / chat requests.

panels.title: Hit rate by layer
panels.description: hits / lookups per layer (bypasses excluded from the denominator).

panels.title: $ saved by layer (range)
panels.description: sum by (layer) (increase(gg_cost_saved_usd_total[$__range])).

panels.title: Semantic distance
panels.description: Nearest-neighbour cosine distance; hits sit below the configured threshold.

panels.title: Lookup p99 by layer
panels.description: Interpolated p99 cache lookup latency.

panels.title: Lookups by result
panels.description: Cache lookups by layer and result.

panels.title: Bypass reasons
panels.description: Requests that skipped the cache, by reason.

panels.title: Store results
panels.description: Cache writes by layer, result and reason.

panels.title: Single-flight and tokens saved
panels.description: Lock outcomes on misses, and upstream tokens avoided by hits.

panels.title: Tier mix
panels.description: Router decisions per second by tier.

panels.title: Decision reasons
panels.description: Why each tier was chosen; fallback means the scorer failed open.

panels.title: Scorer latency
panels.description: Interpolated p50/p99 of the Jev scorer call (cached answers included).

panels.title: Score heatmap
panels.description: Router score distribution, approx P(strong beats weak).

panels.title: Decision cache hit rate and % strong
panels.description: Scorer answer-cache hits / lookups, and the strong share of decisions.

panels.title: Routing savings (estimate, range)
panels.description: Strong-equivalent cost of weak-routed requests minus their actual cost over the range; same tokens at strong prices.

panels.title: Fallbacks from → to
panels.description: Cross-deployment fallbacks over the range by provider pair and reason.

panels.title: Attempts by result
panels.description: Upstream attempts: ok, retry, fallback, fail.

panels.title: Deployment skips
panels.description: Plan entries skipped without an upstream call (open breaker, tier change, context window, no adapter).

panels.title: Circuit state
panels.description: gg_circuit_state per deployment: 0 closed, 1 half-open, 2 open.

panels.title: Breaker transitions
panels.description: Transitions by deployment, target state and reason.

panels.title: Upstream trouble
panels.description: Credential errors, mid-stream failures and requests that exhausted every deployment.

panels.title: Rate-limit rejections by limit
panels.description: 429/402 refusals by limit (rpm, tpm, concurrency, budget, ...).

panels.title: Budget events
panels.description: Key budget soft/hard limits and fail-open/fail-closed decisions, plus expired holds.

panels.title: Limits backend health
panels.description: Limits backend errors by op; degraded = 1 while the local fallback is active.

panels.title: Decisions by guardrail × action
panels.description: Enforced guardrail verdicts per second.

panels.title: Block rate by guardrail
panels.description: Enforced blocks / enforced decisions per guardrail.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, guardrail) (rate(gg_guardrail_decisions_total{mode="enforce",action="block"}[5m])) / sum by (stage, guardrail) (rate(gg_guardrail_decisions_total{mode="enforce",action!="skip"}[5m]))

panels.title: Shadow would-block rate
panels.description: Shadow-mode guards: would-be blocks / shadow decisions; nothing was blocked.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, guardrail) (rate(gg_guardrail_decisions_total{mode="shadow",action="block"}[5m])) / sum by (stage, guardrail) (rate(gg_guardrail_decisions_total{mode="shadow",action!="skip"}[5m]))

panels.title: Guardrail p99
panels.description: Interpolated p99 check latency per guardrail.

panels.title: Guardrail errors
panels.description: Timeouts, exceptions and overloads; the guard's on_error decides allow/flag/block.

panels.title: PII placeholders
panels.description: Placeholders redacted on input, restored on output, and unmatched.
